subject.title: [security] artifacts pull treats declared zero size as absent and accepts non-empty artifacts

question: Should legacy manifests with an omitted size remain accepted while an explicit size of zero is strictly enforced?
rationale: The current scalar representation conflates omission with zero, so maintainers must confirm whether omission remains a supported compatibility path.

options.title: Preserve Optional Size
options.body: Use presence-aware decoding, continue accepting omitted sizes, and strictly enforce every declared value including zero.

options.title: Require Size Metadata
options.body: Reject manifests without a size and strictly enforce all non-negative declarations, intentionally tightening the manifest contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve Optional Size
recommendation.body: Use presence-aware decoding, continue accepting omitted sizes, and strictly enforce every declared value including zero.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the best available owner for deciding the artifact manifest compatibility contract.
